name: Tamakawa (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Tamakawa village emblem in white: an outlined ring open at the fly with horizontal strokes at the hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Tamakawa, a village in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1974.

features.role: Tamakawa village emblem — an outlined ring open at the fly with horizontal strokes at the hoist
